entries.072928f695d42518: Temairazu, Inc. is a company that operates systems for accommodation facilities and a comparison site, and its number of employees as of June 30, 2026 was 44.
entries.0b1a8b9b9a487f0a: This business provides services centered on the TEMAIRAZU series of accommodation booking site controllers to accommodation facilities such as hotels and ryokan. An accommodation booking site controller is a service that centrally manages inventory, rates and other information across multiple accommodation booking sites and the company's own accommodation booking engine. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,408 million.

entries.41f1900b423ba278: The company states as its management philosophy: 'Aim to eliminate people's effort through collaboration with things and events around the world, so that the many encounters and time created enrich society.' In the Application Service Business, to address labor shortages and operational efficiency challenges at accommodation facilities, it states that it will develop systems that improve operational efficiency and convenience, strengthen links with sales channels and add new functions so that its products are chosen, and further spread 'TEMAIRAZU' through company-wide integrated support. In the Internet Media Business, it states that it aims to increase revenue by making the service used by even more people through search engine optimization, improvements to the user interface, and expanded content and added categories. In the following fiscal year, it expects to make investments in human resources, development investment to strengthen functions, and system investment including security measures.

entries.77e993d3635bf81d: Of revenue of ¥2,414 million for the fiscal year ended June 2026, the Application Service Business accounted for ¥2,408 million, nearly all of it. The Internet Media Business has seen its site users decline under the influence of search engine algorithms, and its revenue has shrunk to ¥5 million. The company's business is, in substance, centered on providing booking management systems for accommodation facilities.
entries.787df996b7d7374c: This business provides services centered on the TEMAIRAZU series of accommodation booking site controllers to accommodation facilities such as hotels and ryokan.
entries.877135483b22ece4: In the fiscal year ended June 2026, the company expanded linkages with domestic and overseas booking sites and with payment and fee systems in the Application Service Business. Through a collaboration with NTT DATA, it has also started a service that links a business-to-business payment mechanism with 'TEMAIRAZU', automating everything from accommodation bookings made via overseas booking sites through to payment and settlement. Because inbound tourists remained at a high level, accommodation bookings increased and monthly variable income rose, and with more new contracts, monthly fixed income also increased.
